openai.whatIs: Your OpenAI API key is a private token that lets this app send requests through your OpenAI account.
openai.credits: If your account has no prepaid balance (or no available free credits/quota), requests can stop until you add funds or your quota resets.
openai.freeModels: Free options (Jan 2026): OpenAI doesn't provide model-specific ':free' API variants in this app. OpenAI API usage is still subject to usage tiers and rate limits.

google.whatIs: Your Google API key connects this app to your Gemini API project in AI Studio/Google Cloud.
google.credits: If free-tier quota is exhausted or paid billing is not available, requests fail until quota resets or billing is enabled.
google.freeModels: Free options (Jan 2026): gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash, and gemini-2.5-flash-lite have free-tier access, but with strict RPM/TPM/RPD limits.

anthropic.whatIs: Your Anthropic API key authenticates calls to Claude models from your organization account.
anthropic.credits: Anthropic enforces monthly spend limits per tier; once reached, API usage pauses until your next cycle or a higher tier/deposit.
anthropic.freeModels: Free options (Jan 2026): no model-specific free Claude API variants are documented; Claude API models are metered and rate-limited.

openrouter.whatIs: Your OpenRouter API key authorizes requests and applies usage to your OpenRouter account.
openrouter.credits: If your OpenRouter balance is negative, you may receive 402 errors, including for free models, until your balance is topped up.
openrouter.freeModels: Free options (Jan 2026): use openrouter/free (Free Models Router). Free variants have tighter limits.

deepseek.whatIs: Your DeepSeek API key authenticates calls to DeepSeek models from your account.
deepseek.credits: DeepSeek API usage is metered; if your balance is exhausted, requests will fail until you add funds.
deepseek.freeModels: Free options: DeepSeek does not currently offer free API tiers.

azure.whatIs: Your Azure API key connects this app to your Azure OpenAI Service deployment.
azure.credits: Azure OpenAI usage is billed through your Azure subscription; if your subscription or spending limit is reached, requests will fail.
azure.freeModels: Free options: Azure OpenAI does not offer free-tier API access; usage is billed per token.
